author: FractalDataWorks
name: Reference endpoint group
description: An endpoint group package: the group collection, its EndpointBase, one endpoint and its declaring TypeOption. The option is what puts the route on the wire — an endpoint without one compiles and 404s.

RoutePrefix.description: The URL segment this group's endpoints live under, e.g. api/v1/samples.

Permission.description: The permission prefix the endpoint's right is stated under, e.g. "samples" for samples:read. Required: an endpoint with no right needs no sign-in.

Mode.description: What to generate. Plain: the group and one plain FastEndpoints endpoint. Base: the group and the open-generic abstract endpoint base for the operation, a Crud base with the resource name, OpenAPI summary, description and tag stated and its generics left open. Seal: the group and a concrete endpoint class that closes the generics of the Crud base for the operation, with its option.

choices.description: A plain FastEndpoints endpoint with its right stated.
The abstract endpoint base, generics open.
A concrete endpoint class that closes the generics of the Crud base.

Operation.description: Which operation this endpoint performs. Sets the verb and route to the convention the reference stack uses: GET lists and single reads, POST creates, PATCH modifies, DELETE removes. PUT is not used.

choices.description: PATCH api/v1/{prefix}/{id} — modifies one; the request DTO is nullable throughout.
